record.question: In which of the following clinical conditions should mannitol be used?
options: Head injury with raised intracranial pressure
record.explanation: Answer C: Head injury with raised intracranial pressure. Mannitol is an osmotic agent used in selected patients with raised intracranial pressure, including some traumatic brain injury contexts. Source/context note: Use is case-specific; mannitol can worsen renal injury or hypotension. Reference: https://braintrauma.org/coma/guidelines/severe-tbi-4th-edition. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
